title: Joomiraawo Mo Taƴi Leydi
intro: Miijo-ɗee laamɗo baawɗo, rokkaama semmbe e laamu dow leydi ndii. Ndeeɗoo limoore fuɗɗii ko e yah-ngartaa keewɗo faayiida, haa yettii ɗo naange muti e nokku ɗo naange fuɗi ɗoo, hawri e leƴƴi keewɗi, hawri e caɗeele mawɗe ummoraade e leƴƴi ɗiɗi bonɗi. Hol oo gardiiɗo enigmatik?
clues: Miin ko mi laamɗo keɓaaɗo laamu e kaɓirɗe ngam yettaade nokkuuji ɓurɗi woɗɗude e leydi.
Mi yahi haa hirnaange, mi seedtii naange ina fuɗa e nder ɓuuɓol murtungol.
Mi hawri e leñol sara naange fuɗnaange ngol alaa ɗo ɓuuɓol maggol.
Renndo woɗngo naamndii ballal am e leƴƴi ɗiɗi bonɗi anndiraaɗi Gog e Magog.
Mi mahii barmeeji kuutortooɗi njamndi e njamndi mboɗeeri ngam jogaade ɗi.
Mi anndinii wonde ndee ɗoo barke ko yurmeende ummoraade e joom am, maa ɗum heddo haa waktu toɗɗaaɗo oo.

outcome.answer: Gog e Magog ndartinaama haa wakkati toɗɗaaɗo oo yottii

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
